name: Arcane Craft (Item Creation)
body:
Your innate talent allows you to use sheer genius in place of skill or prowess.

Prerequisite: Boggle, Int 15.

Benefit: You may create a magic item without the requisite item creation feat, though this increases the DC by +5.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
